title: Book Two · Chapter 144: The Long Seat
story:
On a clear Sunday, Dad checks Ronan's blue bike again. Ronan is thirteen now. His knees look too close to the handlebars.

Dad moves the seat within its safe marks. He checks the frame and brakes, then asks Ronan to sit.

“Try here.”

Ronan puts one foot on the ground. The bike feels different, but it is still the same blue frame with the old bell.

“Can it keep growing?”

“No,” Dad says. “Only you do that.”

“An unfair bike.”

They walk it to the square. Mum comes with her walking shoes and a book in her bag. She plans to sit after her walk.

Ronan rides slowly around the open part. He can turn cleanly now. Dad does not need to stay beside the back wheel, but he watches from the edge.

Leo arrives on foot. He has no ball.

“Can I try?” he asks.

Ronan looks at Dad. Dad checks that Leo can reach the pedals and the ground. Then he lets Leo take a short turn. Leo starts well, then makes a very large circle.

“You are visiting the whole square,” Ronan calls.

“I like to see the sights.”

Leo stops beside them and gives the bike back. His face is warm.

Ronan rings the bell once. The sound is still small and clear.

Mum returns from her walk. “Does the bicycle want a rest?”

“It cannot speak,” Dad says.

“It rang.”

Ronan parks it beside the wall. The four of them sit in a row, though Dad's knees still need the most space.

Leo talks about his possible move. He does not want his parents to choose only from school pictures.

“I want to see a normal day there,” he says.

Mum nods. “That sounds like a useful question to ask.”

Ronan watches a little child run after a leaf. He wants to ask Leo if he will miss their games. But he is afraid to ask in front of Mum and Dad.

Leo nudges his shoe.

“If I go, I still want the cake report.”

Ronan laughs. “You must send yours.”

“Mine will be longer.”

“Your cake is not.”

They stay until two families need the space near the wall. Dad rises first. Ronan takes the bike by the handlebar and waits for the little child to pass.

At home, he parks clear of the gate. He looks at the blue frame for a moment. He remembers riding it when he was much smaller.

Dad brings the water inside. Mum takes out her book. Ronan joins them at the table. He sits in his usual chair and stretches his legs.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

handlebar＝车把；frame＝车架；fit＝适合尺寸；normal＝普通的。

## 理解问题

1. 蓝车怎样随着Ronan长大做有限调整？
2. Leo对考察新学校提出什么要求？

## 读句子

**Ronan / parks it / beside the wall.** Ronan／把车停在／墙边。
